shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"
rg 'interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject|interface Options' node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30
rg 'reanchor' scripts -g '*.mjs' || true
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show HEAD -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,280p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'node_modules/ajv|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head -30
sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/ajv/package.json
sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts
rg -n 'ajv' node_modules/@types -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '4888,4920p' package-lock.json
sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts
rg -n 'declare module .ajv.|interface Options|ErrorParameters' src *.d.ts **/*.d.ts --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' 2>/dev/null | head -50
npm ls ajv --depth=0"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json
node -e \"const Ajv=require('ajv'); const a=new Ajv({strict:false,validateFormats:false}); const v=a.compile({type:'object',properties:{location:{type:'string'}},required:['location']}); v({location:42}); console.log(v.errors)\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,120p'
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
git commit -m "Report tool validation paths safely"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD)" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
